meta.name: apolloDJ PRO
meta.description: Single source of truth for the complete apolloDJ Windows system after the full _references/map.md audit. Every reference repo is wired with a Top-3 Podium (primary + 1-2 fallbacks). 2026-06-17: + f3 pendrive tester (podium.pendrive_health, pendrive_tester), + Master XML SSOT heart (master_xml.py), + TODO 6.0 safe-flows audit (safe_flows_audit: auth device_mismatch, hardened version gate min_v/action/fail-closed/unlock_code).

legacy_archives.purpose: Read-only reference for dynamic module loading via importlib.util

apollo_p2p_integrated.policy: apolloDJ is 100% ONE system. P2P is an embedded headless backend inside apolloDJ.exe — never a separate Nicotine+ app, installer, or login UI.

bundle.graceful_degrade: InboxWatcher runs without binary; search/download gated

step_02_apollo_p2p.never_separate_product: No Nicotine+ installer, shortcut, or UI — embedded in apolloDJ.exe only

storage_layout.compatibility_note: All Python variable names preserved (TRACKS_COLETANEA_DIR, CACHE_DIR, INBOX_DIR, LOGS_DIR, CONFIG_DIR, DB_DIR) — only path values changed to pt-BR accented names.

Tracks.0. Em Análise: Staging — drop + apolloDJ P2P backend + pipeline_v2 (atomic commit source)
Tracks.Coletânea: MASTER LIBRARY — canonical filename + analysis + sidecar

storage_layout.Playlists: Unified playlist XML + Rekordbox + Serato + universal CDJ

Pendrives.pendrives-registrados.csv: USB history log: timestamp + health + speed + quality
Pendrives.Exportados: Per-drive export bundles (Rekordbox XML + Serato + CDJ)

Dados.impressoes-digitais.db: Fingerprint-first dedup DB (chromaprint → ffmpeg PCM sha256)
Dados._note: Cache + DB + analyses absorbed into single fast path — Database/ removed.

v2_flow.principle: async + staged + fingerprint-driven + metadata-first — zero duplicate DSP, never freezes UI, crash-safe via atomic os.replace and XML-after-file commit ordering

performance_stack.fingerprint: chromaprint (acoustid) → ffmpeg PCM sha256 → raw sha256

chain: 03_loudness (dual-pass loudnorm, CDJ specs, dynaudnorm if weak)

podium.principle: Each feature defines a Top-3 Podium: 1st = most precise + accurate; 2nd and 3rd = lightweight fallbacks. Primaries try first; on ImportError / RuntimeError the chain steps down. Result: zero hard dependencies on heavy libs (priority C honored).

bpm_detection.2nd: apolloBPK (apollodj.ingest.bpm_key_detection — BeatNet-equivalent CRNN→DBN, librosa-only; our reimplementation studied from BeatNet)
bpm_detection.3rd: legacy hybrid_bpm.py (madmom + beat_this + wavebeat consensus, bounded subprocess)

spectral_features.1st: spectral.spectral_features (librosa bands + DFA danceability — studied from essentia, our version)

energy_score.1st: legacy energy_analyzer.py (RMS + spectral centroid + transient density)
energy_score.note: spectral.spectral_features supplies multi_band_energy + danceability for Stack C / hotcues

audio_qc.1st: ffmpeg ebur128 + astats + spectral centroid + adaptive 99.5% threshold

loudness_normalization.1st: ffmpeg DUAL-PASS loudnorm (measure JSON → apply linear=true I=-14 TP=-1 LRA=measured; force 44.1k/2ch/s16; optional dynaudnorm=gausssize=3 for weak tracks)
loudness_normalization.2nd: slhck/ffmpeg-normalize Python API (two-pass EBU R128 batch)

headroom.1st: M-Igashi/headroom Rust binary (mp3rgain built-in, no limiter, Rekordbox Auto Gain exact)

downbeat_detection.1st: downbeat.downbeat_detection (librosa activations + bar Viterbi — studied from BeatNet/madmom, our version)

song_structure.2nd: apolloSEC (apollodj.ingest.section_detection — Foote SSM + checkerboard novelty + k-means, librosa+scipy only; studied from madmom/BeatNet logic, our version)

onset_smart_cues.1st: onset_cues.onset_smart_cues (librosa.onset + scipy peaks + beat merge — studied from aubio, our version)

smart_hotcues.1st: structure sections + downbeats + energy peaks (Stack C)

tag_writing.1st: mutagen ID3 (TBPM/TKEY/TXXX) + FLAC native + MP4 atoms

p2p_discovery.1st: apolloDJ embedded headless (bundled p2p/nicotine.exe + pynicotine + apollo_backend.conf)
p2p_discovery.2nd: pynicotine in-process (search + download + share folder only)

usb_export.1st: exporters.rekordbox_xml (PIONEER CDJ native — pyrekordbox writer + hand-rolled XML fallback)
usb_export.3rd: exporters.universal_cdj (PIONEER/USBANLZ + DJ Music/ raw layout — ANLZ if available, XML always)

pendrive_health.1st: f3 (Fight Flash Fraud) — f3probe (quick) / f3write+f3read (full): fake-capacity + real speed + bad blocks, live streaming (pendrive_utils.run_f3_test_streaming)
pendrive_health.2nd: usb_exporter.usb_health_check (16 MB write/read speed benchmark, cached 60 s)

pendrive_tester.philosophy: Minimal new files, maximum power — reuses Pendrives/, quality_gate, usb_exporter, registry.
pendrive_tester.binary_discovery: APOLLODJ_F3_BIN (dir or file) -> shutil.which(f3probe|f3write|f3read) -> known winget/install dirs

modes.quick: f3probe — fast fake-capacity health check, writes no data (default)
modes.full: f3write + f3read — real write/read speed + bad-block/data-loss integrity

pendrive_tester.streaming: subprocess.Popen line-by-line -> on_progress(speed/percent/fake) + on_line callbacks; timeout + graceful kill
pendrive_tester.health_score: weighted 0-100: capacity 40 (0 if fake) + write 25/10 (>15 MB/s) + read 20/10 (>20 MB/s) + integrity 15/0 (bad_blocks==0)
pendrive_tester.quality_gate: quality_gate.check_usb_health(usb_result, audio_score?) -> {export_allowed, usb_health_score, badge, reasons, combined_score?}
pendrive_tester.export_guard: usb_exporter._f3_export_guard blocks export on fake/low-health last test; APOLLODJ_REQUIRE_F3_TEST=1 forces a test first

safe_flows_audit.purpose: Verifies src_002 follows the MINIMUM FLOWS from the attached reference codes (auth contract, version gate, master XML SSOT, nicotine creds).
reference_codes: apollo_dj_safe_flows (2).py (version gate: min_v + action=lock, fail-closed, paid unlock)
apollo_xml_pro_lock.py (Master XML SSOT heart — cross-process lock + dedup)
safe_flows_audit.auth: constants.API_BASE=/wp-json/apollo/v1 · APP_ID=apollodj · X-Apollo-App-Token + X-Apollo-Device-Id · auth_gate verify-first + dj/permissions ?app_id patch · NEW: device_mismatch -> AuthResult.reason + logout (re-login on this machine)
safe_flows_audit.version_gate: update_check.get_update_gate(current, manifest?, fail_closed=True, unlocked?) honors min_v + action=='lock', fail-CLOSED offline, paid unlock_code (keyring), self_clean/self_delete/broken hooks. get_boot_gate now honors min_v/action first (offline-grace fail_open). Original latest_version/mandatory path preserved.

master_xml.principle: ONE master XML (heart) pumps web/desktop/Pioneer/playlists. Track defined once in <COLLECTION> with stable TrackID=sha256(path)[:16]; <PLAYLISTS> hold TrackID refs only — zero audio/metadata duplication.
master_xml.api: stable_track_id() · locked_apollo_xml() (cross-process exclusive lock + atomic os.replace) · ApolloXMLStore.{ensure_track_in_collection, add_track_to_playlist(dedup->bool), remove_track_from_playlist, get_playlist_track_ids, export_to_rekordbox}
master_xml.deps: stdlib-only (ElementTree); optional filelock auto-used if installed, else O_CREAT|O_EXCL spin-lock (priority C — no hard dep)
master_xml.relation: Rekordbox DJ_PLAYLISTS-style export heart; complements the fingerprint-keyed internal SSOT in xml_db.py (coletanea.aprio.xml)

safe_flows_audit.nicotine_creds: EQUIVALENT-OR-BETTER: existing generate_nicotine_credential uses deterministic SHA-256 (zero Soulseek duplicate accounts) — kept over the reference username*2 scheme which would collide and break the _audit_001 deterministic check.

usb_export.trigger: User selects a playlist and chooses an exported USB drive

library_ui.principle: Two structurally identical aside cards — COMPUTADOR (raw machine folders) and PLAYLISTS (Rekordbox-style lists bound to ONE central audio folder, zero duplicate audio).

computador.meaning: Real local computer folders the DJ browses — NOT the managed library.
computador.add_fixed_folder: [+] (#lib-add-folder-btn) → ingest.pick_folder() native picker (prompt fallback) — persists extra fixed local folders.
computador.hide_option: Every listed folder (defaults + added) has a per-row eye toggle; header eye (#lib-toggle-hidden) reveals/hides the hidden set. Persisted in localStorage 'apollodj.computador.v1' + mirrored to ingest.save_computer_folders().
computador.on_add_to_playlist: Drag / click / right-click a COMPUTADOR folder or file onto ANY playlist → ingest.add_path_to_playlist(path, playlistView) runs the full flow (pipeline_v2 + dj_prep_pro): analyse → rename → save audio into ~/apolloDJ/Tracks/Coletânea (central unique folder).
analysis_outputs: gain_eq (Rekordbox Auto Gain / Berlin club prep)
computador.quality_gate: quality_gate.score weighted >=80 → club-playable; below → flag. cdj_auditor + audio_qc decide club readiness.

warning_symbol.trigger: Any analysis/QC problem that could harm a live club set (clipping, low bitrate, corruption, loudness/headroom failure, CDJ incompatibility).
warning_symbol.ui: Yellow .lib-cpt-warn (ri-error-warning-fill, #f5b400) on the row; native title tooltip explains shortly on :hover.
warning_symbol.source: ingest.list_computer_folders() folder.warn = { msg } or per-track sidecar quality flags.

playlists.meaning: NOT folders — converted lists imported from Rekordbox-standard XML/xlsm/xlm, mirroring CDJ/XDJ playlist structure.
playlists.central_audio_folder: ~/apolloDJ/Tracks/Coletânea — single source of truth; playlists reference tracks by path + fingerprint key (parsers.track_model), NEVER copy audio → zero duplicated audio files.
playlists.dedup: Dados/impressoes-digitais.db (chromaprint → ffmpeg PCM sha256 → raw sha256); fingerprint HIT attaches playlistRef only and SKIPS analysis.
playlists.hide_option: Same per-row eye toggle as COMPUTADOR for playlists / groups.

methods: list_computer_folders() -> { folders: [{ id, label, icon, path, hidden, warn:{msg} }] }
add_path_to_playlist(path, playlist_view) -> ingest job (pipeline_v2 + dj_prep_pro, commit to Coletânea)
bridge_surface.degrade: No pywebview bridge (browser preview) → defaults render, [+] uses prompt, drops show a connect toast — page never breaks.

marcar_tools.where: stage toolbar #djp-markTools (seg--mark) — armed tool shows accent + crosshair + #djp-markBadge hint
marcar_tools.flow: arm a tool → click the waveform → marker created at the snapped bar (notes at exact time); reuses selectEntity() to jump + open its editor card.
